description: Product-fit guide: decide whether a job belongs to Direct (reach a participating business by its phone number) or Gate (limit what an agent may call on your own HTTPS API, with approvals and an audit log). Returns use_when, not_for, first_steps, connection details and limits for each. Gate itself is a separate MCP server (https://gate.odilelabs.com/mcp) with its own tools, none of which are on this server, while Direct runs here. Use it before connecting either one; Direct's skills and costs are in get_m2m_network. Static, takes no arguments, needs no sign-in, reads no account and contacts no business.
name: get_agent_services
title: When to use OdileM2M, Direct or Gate
